method: Actual production bundle in Codex IAB through documented browser controls; visible DOM, screenshots and keyboard interaction. No hidden game state was invoked.

desktop.weather: Explicitly labelled recorded model fixture during measurement
desktop.detailsOpenDownloadClose: passed for all three exports without the former oversized inventory DOM

guestBoundary.companion: One authenticated synthetic SDK player on the same isolated server
guestBoundary.guestPeoplePanel: Jsi v samostatném světě. Žádní hráči ani jejich data se sem neposílají.
guestBoundary.reloadBehavior: Reload shows the entrance screen; explicit re-entry returns to two players, with the companion visible and no duplicate player in the displayed count.

limits: Screenshots were inspected and emitted in the chat; this JSON does not claim locally archived screenshot files.
Viewport emulation is not a physical phone or a touch-control usability test.
Normal reload and re-entry were checked; no synthetic browser WebSocket outage or forced Game.reconcile input-backlog reset was injected.
Forced backlog behavior uses the separate SDK integration and measured network cohort; public Internet conditions remain untested.
The HUD improvement is not a complete accessibility audit of every existing panel.
